title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: paying an approved settlement and closing the claim
content:
## Scope

This policy of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line governs the closure of a decided claim on a cover and the payment of an approved settlement. The settlement account of a cover records approved settlements not yet paid, raised on approval and reduced on payment.

## Policy clause

1. A decided claim closes the open claim on the cover, whether it was settled or rejected.
2. An approved settlement is paid to the claimant in full, for the amount approved, within the product's settlement payment period in calendar days of approval, referencing the approval entry. It is never paid in instalments by the desk.
3. Where the product withholds settlement while premium is unpaid, the settlement is paid only once the unpaid premium on the cover is 0.00. The unpaid premium is read from the cover's record.
4. A settlement may be paid only on a cover whose status is the open-claim or the closed-claim state.
5. Each approved claim is paid once.
6. A settlement approved at 0.00 is closed without a payment entry.

## Condition, judgement, action

| Situation | Judgement | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Claim decided by settlement or by rejection | The open claim ends | The claim is closed on the cover |
| Settlement approved, product withholds for unpaid premium, unpaid premium above 0.00 | Payment held | Paid once the unpaid premium is 0.00 |
| Settlement approved at 0.00 | Nothing to pay | Closed without a payment entry |
| A payment already recorded for the approved claim | Already paid | Not paid again |

## Hypothetical cases

- **Case A (hypothetical figures):** a settlement of 4,200.00 USD is approved on a cover showing 180.00 USD of unpaid premium, under a product that withholds settlement while premium is unpaid. The 4,200.00 USD is paid, in full, only once the unpaid premium is 0.00.
- **Case B (hypothetical):** the claimant asks for half the approved settlement now and half later. The desk never pays a settlement in instalments; it is paid in full for the amount approved.
